newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-NBA'S RADZA TO SIGN FOR PANATHINAIKOS.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-NBA'S RADZA TO SIGN FOR PANATHINAIKOS.

text.p: Croat forward Dino Radza of the Boston Celtics is expected to sign a two-year contract with Greek club Panathinaikos for an estimated $3.0 million, club officials said on Wednesday.
Radza arrived in Athens on Tuesday and was undergoing medical tests. A leg injury kept him benched for most of last season with the Celtics in the NBA.

"Dino is here to sign. The flirtation (with Radza) is an old one and now the time has come for it to be realised. It is a dream come true," Thanasis Yannakopoulos, brother of Panathinaikos' president Pavlos Yannakopoulos told reporters.
Radza, 30, said he was trying to get out of his contract with the Celtics and Panathinaikos officials said they expected this to happen within the next two days.
Panathinaikos are the most expensively assembled basketball club in Europe, but after a disappointing season will be in the Korac Cup next season, not the prestigious EuroLeague.
On Tuesday, the EuroLeague champions of 1996 signed a $2.3 million, two-year contract with NBA veteran guard Byron Scott.
Scott, 36, has played 11 of his 14 NBA seasons with the Los Angeles Lakers.
